actual: The real MA-E19R3 2026H1 expanding panel first returned NOT_COMPUTABLE reason_code=qe_p0_d2_within_sector_coverage_insufficient because 615 legitimate date-sector groups were singletons. After removing that over-broad precheck, hard Top-M cells then returned qe_p0_d2_selection_coverage_insufficient when sparse selected sectors provided fewer stocks than the configured Top-K. Both checks incorrectly treated a valid signal-ceiling sample shape as corrupt input: within-sector RankIC is undefined only for singleton/degenerate groups, while hard Top-M naturally defines Top-K as a cap rather than a guaranteed portfolio size.
